_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_copy_set_types.py. t_eaxt_effigy is Machine God's Effigy's type clause without its quoted mana ability: an artifact that may enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact. t_eaxt_mirror is the same clause until end of turn. t_eaxt_golem is an Artifact Creature - Equipment Golem, so a copy that is only an Artifact keeps the artifact subtype and loses the creature one.

cards.name: Test Effigy
cards.oracle_text: You may have this artifact enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact. (It's not a creature.)

cards.name: Test Effigy Mirror
cards.oracle_text: You may have this artifact enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it's an artifact.
